title: Dungeon decorator: furnishing by room role, cobwebs, pots, spike strips, dart traps on pressure plates with planned wires, prop preloading
player_outcome: Every room tells you what it is: libraries full of bookcases and shelves, barracks with tables, treasure rooms with a chest on a dais between statues, spike pits bridged by platforms. Chandeliers and banners line the halls, cobwebs hang in corners, and pressure plates fire hidden dart traps. It streams in without hitches.
design: New src/Strata.Core/WorldGen/Structures/Dungeon/DungeonDecorator.cs, with a Rooms partial. It emits ObjectOps and small Fills after DungeonBuilder, from rng stream 'dungeon.decor'.

Helper RotationFacing(dir): rotation 0 faces −Z, 1 +X, 2 +Z, 3 −X (as in WireSystem.FireTrap). Wall objects stand in the interior cell next to the wall and face inward; ceiling objects sit flush with the ceiling.
Keep an occupied-cell set so no two ObjectOps overlap (TileObjectStore.TryAdd silently rejects overlaps).
Halls: every 12–16 cells alternate banner, lamp and candelabra. Pots (existing 'pot', random variant) in 1–3 clusters per segment. Cobweb blocks (Fill onlyAir 'cobweb' 2×2×2) in upper corners, 40%.
Hall spike strips: 15% of flat halls get a centred strip ≤ 5 cells long (jumpable) of 'spike' objects.

Hall traps: 10% of flat halls get a pressure_plate on the floor and a dart_trap in the side wall at chest height (carve its cell first, face across the hall). Wire cells run along an L-shaped path under the floor from plate to trap.
Planned wires are recorded in a new WorldPlan.PlannedWires set. WorldSession.Create seeds Session.Wires from it (new worlds only).

Library: 3–6 bookcases on the walls, plus platform-shaped brick shelves at 3 heights holding book objects at 60% fill. About 1 in 40 books gets PendingLoot 'water_bolt_book', guaranteeing ≥ 1 per dungeon. A table, chair and candle.
Treasure: a 1-cell brick dais with a gold_chest (locked in P4-21), 2 statues, 2 candelabras and a banner.
Barracks: 2 tables, 4 chairs, vases, pots, a chandelier.
SpikePit: a spike floor with a platform bridge.
Vault: reserve 6 chest spots for P4-34.
Budgets: ≤ 40 objects and ≤ 6 light sources per chunk (counted while placing).

Godot prop preloading. Add PropLibrary.Preload(IEnumerable<string>) with a queue that loads one GLB per frame. When the player comes within 64 m of the dungeon_gate landmark (or on load inside it), game/World/TileObjectRenderer.cs enqueues DungeonFeature.ObjectIds' model paths, so no first-use GLB load stalls a frame in the dungeon.
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/WorldGen/Passes/DungeonPass.cs — run the decorator, fill PlannedWires, expose ObjectIds
game/World/TileObjectRenderer.cs — trigger preloading near the dungeon
tests: DungeonDecorTests.SteppingOnADungeonPlateFiresItsDart: install the chunk, stand on the plate, projectiles increase.
Smoke dungeon.cmds: 'flag defeated_skeletron', 'tp landmark dungeon_bottom', 'wait_until stream.idle == 1 600', 'assert props.problems == 0', 'assert errors == 0'.
verification: perf: 'perf start', walk the halls with 'hold move_forward 20', 'perf report'. No frame > 33 ms from gd.objects/uploads on the medium preset.
lavapipe screenshots of a library and a treasure room
risks: MultiMesh draw calls per chunk grow with object variety; the ≤ 40 objects cap and one colour per dungeon contain it. The perf phase may also change TileObjectRenderer budgets, so coordinate.
Wire seeding only for new worlds is fine: old worlds are disposable.
